title: codemother-reaches-system-word-through-its-package
intention: CodeMother's shim reaches the system_word tool only through its declared interface: the one import at cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:326 names cairn.tools.system_word instead of the undeclared inner module, so the one 'undeclared' encapsulation finding against system_word clears.
why: Measured 2026-10-05: encapsulation_breaches('.') returns one row with target cairn/tools/system_word, reason 'undeclared', from cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py:326 ('from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word', a function-local import inside _handle_sealed, added by b984567d8c05). system_word's charter declares only cairn.tools.system_word, whose __init__ re-exports is_word, and every other caller in the repo imports from there. The lived symptom: whoever reshapes system_word's inner module sees no declared caller in codemother, and _handle_sealed (the path every seal crosses a boat through) breaks on a change system_word said touched nobody.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation, CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-rule-1-encapsulation.md); Law 4 (encapsulation_holds is the physics). Child of 8e3474a6ae43 (rule-1-encapsulation), falsifier (3).
how: One line in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py: line 326 '        from cairn.tools.system_word.system_word import is_word' becomes '        from cairn.tools.system_word import is_word'. A new proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reaches_system_word_through_its_package.py reads the live encapsulation_breaches, sealed red before the edit and green after. test_codemother.py (33/33 at HEAD) runs before and after as the regression check.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector.encapsulation_breaches(<repo root>) returns no row whose file starts with 'cairn/devices/codemother/' and whose target is 'cairn/tools/system_word', and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py still reports 33 passed, 0 failed. RED if either fails. WRONG INTENT if system_word's charter meant its inner module to be public. Horizon: PROVED, then the next live inspector pass shows 0 rows on system_word.
watchme: none, because encapsulation_holds runs inside build_inspector (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) at every PROVEME of every component, and its findings ARE the report
children: none, because the change is one import line and one proof
